name: New Ravenspire
lore: The Shadow Legion's fortified capital, founded by Seraphina in Eldoria after the Great Darkness.

buildings.name: The Spire Hall of the Legion

signs.text: NEW RAVENSPIRE — seat of the Shadow Legion. Founded by Seraphina after the Great Darkness. Inside: the Black Raven (inn), the Legion Armoury, the Map-Maker, the Guild Exchange; the market; the palace square. East gate: the road to the Obsidian Gate. South: the Great Rift — keep to the road.

people.name: Innkeeper of the Black Raven
people.greeting: A bed under the Spires, a fire, no questions. The Legion pays its debts here, and so do travellers.

people.name: Legion Quartermaster
people.greeting: Black steel, made for the Rift's things. Outsiders pay full price — for now.

people.name: The Map-Maker
people.greeting: Maps of the Scarlands, the Rift's edges — and a few of the other side, for those with the stomach.

people.name: Exchange Factor
people.greeting: Goods from both worlds pass through this hall. Mind the prices; mind the company.

people.name: Herald of the Legion
lines: Seraphina led our people out of the dark through the Rift. We built these walls with what we carried.
The Great Rift still bleeds: things from the other side crawl out of it. The bounty is good for any you put down.
The Obsidian Gate stands to the east. The Legion guards it, but travellers may pass — at their own risk.
Outsiders are welcome while they keep the peace. The Legion remembers who helps it.

people.name: Market Trader
people.greeting: Bread, salt, oil, rope. Even a Legion eats.

people.name: Palace Guard
lines: The Lady of the Spires does not receive travellers. Admire the palace from the square.
Keep the peace inside the walls.

people.name: Palace Guard
lines: Seraphina built the Gate with her own hands. Remember that, outsider.

people.name: Legion Gate-Warden
lines: Pass, traveller. Keep your blade sheathed inside the walls.
The Rift's things grow bolder after dark. Stay on the road.
